build_host: x86_64 linux, offline (no network during extraction or build)

cached_image_crosscheck.result: both guest-image debs verify against the same signed CHECKSUMS; the guest image and these headers are the same publisher build

compiler_note: the kernel itself was built with x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc-15 (Ubuntu 15.2.0-12ubuntu1); the headers' default CC names gcc-15, which is absent here, so this out-of-tree module build passes CC=gcc explicitly
determinism: byte-identical across three independent kbuild/module-build locations (sha 923c7082...); -g0 drops debug sections and -ffile-prefix-map neutralizes the __FILE__ path from dma-mapping.h; readelf finds zero build-path strings
note: test-only oracle module for the pinned 7.0.14 stress guest; loads with plain insmod (no --force); symbol CRCs come from the headers' Module.symvers of the same publisher build the guest boots
pahole_note: pahole absent at build time; kbuild skips module BTF generation (vmlinux unavailable); the module loads without BTF
